profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a software company that offers an AI-powered meeting assistant, which it describes as the "#1 AI Teammate for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." The product takes notes, manages tasks, and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM platforms, and other connected applications, with the stated goal of building a searchable knowledge base of a team's work in a single place.

The core product operates through an AI agent named Fred, reachable at fred@fireflies.ai, which can be invited to live meetings or set to automatically join calendar meetings in order to record, transcribe, and summarize them. A feature set called AI Skills enables users to extract key details from meetings, generate follow-up emails, score job candidates, and surface other insights automatically.

The site holds a tracked product entry for Fireflies.ai in the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, with a note that meeting transcription makes consent considerations relevant. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
